text: Microsoft Corporation is listed on Nasdaq; per its own 2025 proxy statement, its largest disclosed shareholders are The Vanguard Group, Inc. (8.95%) and BlackRock, Inc. (7.30%). No state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.

source.name: Microsoft Corporation, 2025 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.quote: This table lists all entities that are the beneficial owner of more than 5% of Microsoft common stock.
